method: We took portable ENERGY STAR dehumidifiers certified at 45 to 55 pints per day (the 50-pint class under the current DOE test) and compared the most efficient by IEF, with a 10% weight on capacity. The five-year electricity cost is shown for each (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5). The list stops above a tie for the last place rather than picking among tied models.
name: Best 50-pint dehumidifiers, ranked by certified efficiency
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100

selection.label: Integrated Energy Factor
selection.merge: listings with identical certified values on all 11 reported fields

ties.rule: equal scores share a rank; within it products are listed alphabetically (no measured difference)
